title: Dash and body camera video – stranded motorist assist on I-80 near Rock Springs, April 8, 2023 (meth, fentanyl pills, stolen pistols)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wyoming Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All dash camera (in-car) and body-worn camera video, with audio, recorded by Wyoming Highway Patrol troopers during a motorist assist on Interstate 80 east of Rock Springs, Sweetwater County, on the evening of April 8, 2023. A trooper stopped to help a woman from California whose car had run out of gas. A man from Iowa then came out of a nearby ditch. A drug detection dog named Becky alerted on the car, and troopers found about 11.5 pounds of suspected methamphetamine, about 3.7 pounds of marijuana, 2,186 suspected fentanyl pills and two stolen pistols. Both people were arrested. The incident was described in a Wyoming Highway Patrol news release in April 2023.

I also request the incident and arrest reports and any photographs of the seized drugs and firearms.

I ask that redacted versions be released rather than withholding records in full. Original digital video files are preferred, delivered by download link. If the criminal cases are still open and records are withheld for that reason, please tell me when they may become releasable.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Mattias Jussila
